brief: Build an editorial furniture collection website for design-conscious homeowners. Use warm materials and restrained typography. Make the collection navigation and inquiry form work on desktop and mobile. Avoid a generic card-grid hero.

Build a distinctive independent cinema website for local film lovers. Present the current programme clearly, include functional film filtering and booking selection, and use a cinematic identity without sacrificing mobile readability.

Build a confident developer observability product website. Explain the product with clear technical content and a meaningful product visual. Include a working pricing switch and signup form. Avoid invented customer claims.

Build a bold but readable artist portfolio with project filtering and a usable project detail view. Art should lead the composition. Establish a visual identity that differs from standard SaaS landing pages.

Build a welcoming artisan bakery website focused on daily products and pickup orders. Use a tangible, warm visual identity with strong mobile ordering flow, accessible controls and no fabricated reviews.

Build an understated private travel studio website for thoughtful travellers. Use immersive but purposeful imagery, an original editorial layout and a working trip inquiry form. Preserve readable contrast and reduced-motion support.

Build a premium operations dashboard for a small logistics team. Prioritise hierarchy and practical density rather than decorative gradients. Include working search, date filters and a shipment detail state on mobile.

Build a credible conservation nonprofit website. Lead with clear mission and grounded imagery. Include a functional donation selection flow and navigation. Do not invent impact numbers or endorsements.

Recreate the supplied desktop and mobile reference layouts faithfully. Preserve their typography, proportions, imagery hierarchy and navigation behaviour. Prioritise fidelity over introducing a different visual identity.

Redesign the supplied existing storefront into a distinctive modern shopping experience while preserving its cart, search, product detail routes and API contracts. Improve desktop and mobile composition with targeted changes.
